latest_daily.deep_dive_title: OpenVLHarness: Real World Visual Agentic Tool-Use with Multimodal Memory
latest_daily.daily_action: 把 OpenVLHarness（[2610.26860](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26860)）列为今日即时试点主线，按 capability layer / persistent memory / coding interface 三层写 visual-tool-harness checklist；把 WeAct（[2610.26847](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26847)）与 Agima（[2610.26845](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26845)）列为即时试点第二梯队——分别产出 '_switch_capability 工具可行性评估' 与 'Agima omni 训练成本量级核验（仓库今日实测可达）'；把 AnyGoal（[2610.26844](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26844)）与 LatComm（[2610.26840](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26840)）纳入趋势雷达连续观察；把 FunCAD（[2610.26861](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26861)）、PhysRSI（[2610.26848](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26848)）、VAG（[2610.26856](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26856)）、CoopUQ（[2610.26852](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26852)）、Halcyon（[2610.26863](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26863)）存入长尾库并标注触发条件。
latest_daily.max_uncertainty: 证据不足项明确清单：(1) 今日 10 篇中仅 3 篇有可核验外部证据——CoopUQ（https://github.com/tasl-lab/CoopUQ ，项目页 https://coopuq.github.io/ ）、Agima（https://github.com/Agentic-Imagination/Agima ，项目页 https://agima.net/ ）、Halcyon（https://cs.stanford.edu/~keshik/halcyon ，页面显示 Models 已提供、Code 标注 coming soon）经今日实测均 HTTP 200；其余 7 篇摘要未给出任何代码、benchmark 或项目链接，code_url / benchmark_url 一律留空并标注「暂无可核验链接（待核验/暂无）」，未补写任何推断事实。(2) 所有分数与 SOTA 结论均为作者自述，本次运行未做任何第三方复现；Halcyon 的 gFD 数字（48.0 vs 63.3、35.3 vs 41.0）与 LatComm 的 57x / 3x 均未独立核验。(3) OpenVLHarness 所用的 22 个 benchmark 与 8 个 backbone 的具体清单、以及 GPT-6 Astra / GPT-6 Luna / Codex / Visual Sketchpad 的评测口径需打开 PDF 核验，无法从摘要确认是否同一裁判。(4) Agima 的 40% vs 2% 仅限 Maze2D / Sokoban / Pacman / PushT 四个环境，真实工具链上的迁移效果未知。(5) VAG 自述在六个视觉推理 benchmark 上取得 SOTA 平均分，无第三方复现。(6) LatComm 要求两端模型冻结并支持 cross-attention，摘要中 readable by a different LLM 这句的适用边界论文未给出。(7) FunCAD 摘要只写 substantially improving functional success rates，未给出具体数值与 baseline 清单。
latest_daily.one_line_judgement: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.26860），它先用受控实验否掉了最省事的那条路——'simply increasing the inference budget of the base model yields only modest gains'；然后把收益全部投在 harness 结构上：capability layer（统一异构后端并把输出转成模型可读观测）、persistent multimodal memory（把图像、结构化数据、网页引用作为可寻址 artifact 在整个 query 期间保留）、coding interface（在存好的数据上执行生成程序）。22 个 benchmark × 8 个开源与闭源 backbone 的 matched no-tool 对照给出平均 'improves average scores by 9.7-12.6 points over matched no-tool baselines'；成本侧最硬的一条是 'outperforms the base model, Codex, and Visual Sketchpad at maximum effort by 7.7-8.5 points while incurring at most 37% of their model-token cost'。三层结构今天就可以照着搭。

top_paper.title: OpenVLHarness: Real World Visual Agentic Tool-Use with Multimodal Memory
top_paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made rapid progress on visual reasoning, yet many tasks require evidence that is difficult to obtain through internal reasoning alone: our controlled study on 22 benchmarks shows that simply increasing the inference budget of the base model yields only modest gains. Such tasks demand grounded perception, external knowledge, and numerical measurements obtained through heterogeneous tools, whose outputs must be made interpretable to the model and retai
top_paper.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.26860，published 2026-10-19）：OpenVLHarness 先用受控实验否掉了 'simply increasing the inference budget of the base model yields only modest gains' 这条最省事的路（对照覆盖 22 个 benchmark）；然后把收益做在 harness 结构上——作者自述其 'organized around a capability layer and persistent multimodal memory'。capability layer 的原文是 'The capability layer combines task-level tool interfaces with evidence rendering, providing consistent access to heterogeneous backends and converting their outputs into model-readable observations'；persistent memory 'retains the corresponding images, structured data, and web references as addressable artifacts throughout each query'；coding interface 'executes generated programs over stored data'，从而 'support an iterative process of acquiring, inspecting, and composing multimodal evidence'。证据是 22 个 benchmark × 8 个开源与闭源 backbone 的 matched no-tool 对照：'improves average scores by 9.7-12.6 points over matched no-tool baselines'（Qwen3-VL-8B +11.2、Kimi K3 +9.7、GPT-6 Astra +9.9）；成本侧给了硬数字——'outperforms the base model, Codex, and Visual Sketchpad at maximum effort by 7.7-8.5 points while incurring at most 37% of their model-token cost'。价值路由：这是今日唯一一篇 harness 结构本身可以直接照着搭的论文，属 ai-agent × multimodal-agent × context-engineering × llm-evaluation 的即时资产。代码 / benchmark / 项目页：摘要未给出，暂无可核验链接（待核验/暂无），需打开 PDF 确认 harness 与工具适配协议是否开源。今日动作：按 capability layer / persistent memory / coding interface 三层写 visual-tool-harness checklist。

recent_dailies.max_uncertainty: 今日 10 篇论文均未在摘要里显式披露 code / benchmark / project URL（仅 PDF / arXiv），按规则统一标 '暂无'——所有'代码 / 榜单 / 复现门槛'层面的判断都需打开 PDF 核验；SBL 是否真能跨 wet-lab / dry-lab / simulation rig 都 self-configure、SEER-Repro 的 20 篇论文选取协议是否独立于 LLM 厂商、DiscoveryRSI 的 hypothesis tree 编码是否对 single-agent pipeline 也 work、Behavioral Couplings 的耦合度量是否在不同模型族上稳定、ReDiST 的 student-side conditioning 是否会显著增加训练成本、MFlow 的 adaptive parameterization 是否会带来优化不稳定、QoT 的 compute/simulate/learn 三态选择是否对 fault scenario 鲁棒、ENFR 的 flow-matched reference 是否对 OOD posterior 仍可扩展、量子电路 spectral bias 的 query 编码是否对远端 task 仍闭式、Predictive Allocation 的 two-moment 界是否在非 canonical 模型下成立，仍待多源验证。
recent_dailies.one_line_judgement: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.23826），这篇把 SDL 从 '运行人类设计的流程' 推到 'design, configures, and operates its own laboratory setup'——即让 agent 自己设计 / 配置 / 运维整个实验台，明确点出 'existing SDLs can only run the procedures they were built for. Adapting them to a new experiment still takes extensive manual engineering, which makes laboratory flexibility the bottleneck for scaling discovery'。这是 ai-agent × multimodal-agent × ai-k8s-platform 的 'self-reconfiguring SDL / lab-as-agent' 直接路线资产；与昨日 CoDA（2610.22362 data × policy co-evolution）、DiscoveryRSI（2610.23839 hypothesis-tree RSI）一起构成 'agent4science / agent4SDL' 主线——若 SBL 公开 lab reconfiguration 协议与跨硬件 interface，会成为团队日后做 '内部 self-reconfiguring eval rig' / 'lab-reconfig agent skill' 的直接底座。

recent_dailies.max_uncertainty: 今日 10 篇论文均未在摘要里显式披露 code / benchmark / project URL（仅 PDF / arXiv），按规则统一标 '暂无'——所有'代码 / 榜单 / 复现门槛'层面的判断都需打开 PDF 核验；MLExpert 是否真的能跨 tabular / vision / NLP / time-series 都 work、FDE-Gym 是否公开任务数据 / 评估协议、T2-Z 的 environment latent 是否需要 ground-truth physics、OmniVerifier-C1 的分解协议是否对 OOD prompt 鲁棒、CoDA 的 memory schema 是否泛化到非 embodied agent、LIBERO-PeRM 的 preference 标注协议是否独立于任务成功、PathFM 对 long-horizon trajectory 是否仍可扩展、GeoState 的 view-decoupling 在 cross-camera geometry 极端变化下是否仍稳定、MoE routing exploration 的理论分析是否对所有 share / fine-grained 配置都成立、量子电路 LLM 是否会提供跨量子硬件的可复现脚本，仍待多源验证。
recent_dailies.one_line_judgement: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.22344），这篇把 MLE 从 'workflow 编排' 推到 'model-directed interaction, allowing models to autonomously organize and evolve their own ML engineering process'——即让单个 LLM 自主决定 dataset / feature / pipeline / training config / 训练超参与迭代路径。这是 ai-agent × coding-agent × llm-evaluation 的 'agent4AI / recursive self-improvement' 直接路线资产；与 9 月-10 月 KARO / AIDE / MLAgentBench 主线同源但定位更激进（'generalist agentic'），意味着团队日后做 AutoML / AutoMLOps 不再是写 workflow，而是构造 agent harness + rubric。

top_papers.title: OpenVLHarness: Real World Visual Agentic Tool-Use with Multimodal Memory
top_papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made rapid progress on visual reasoning, yet many tasks require evidence that is difficult to obtain through internal reasoning alone: our controlled study on 22 benchmarks shows that simply increasing the inference budget of the base model yields only modest gains. Such tasks demand grounded perception, external knowledge, and numerical measurements obtained through heterogeneous tools, whose outputs must be made interpretable to the model and retai
top_papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.26860，published 2026-10-19）：OpenVLHarness 先用受控实验否掉了 'simply increasing the inference budget of the base model yields only modest gains' 这条最省事的路（对照覆盖 22 个 benchmark）；然后把收益做在 harness 结构上——作者自述其 'organized around a capability layer and persistent multimodal memory'。capability layer 的原文是 'The capability layer combines task-level tool interfaces with evidence rendering, providing consistent access to heterogeneous backends and converting their outputs into model-readable observations'；persistent memory 'retains the corresponding images, structured data, and web references as addressable artifacts throughout each query'；coding interface 'executes generated programs over stored data'，从而 'support an iterative process of acquiring, inspecting, and composing multimodal evidence'。证据是 22 个 benchmark × 8 个开源与闭源 backbone 的 matched no-tool 对照：'improves average scores by 9.7-12.6 points over matched no-tool baselines'（Qwen3-VL-8B +11.2、Kimi K3 +9.7、GPT-6 Astra +9.9）；成本侧给了硬数字——'outperforms the base model, Codex, and Visual Sketchpad at maximum effort by 7.7-8.5 points while incurring at most 37% of their model-token cost'。价值路由：这是今日唯一一篇 harness 结构本身可以直接照着搭的论文，属 ai-agent × multimodal-agent × context-engineering × llm-evaluation 的即时资产。代码 / benchmark / 项目页：摘要未给出，暂无可核验链接（待核验/暂无），需打开 PDF 确认 harness 与工具适配协议是否开源。今日动作：按 capability layer / persistent memory / coding interface 三层写 visual-tool-harness checklist。

top_papers.abstract: Long-horizon agents must learn heterogeneous capabilities from interleaved trajectories. Updating shared parameters to learn new capabilities can degrade previously acquired ones, resulting in catastrophic forgetting. top_papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.26847）：WeAct 把 '选哪个能力' 直接做成 agent 的一个动作——'trains independent capability-specific LoRA adapters over a frozen backbone and adds adapter selection to the agent's action space'，并明确 'These internal actions use the model's native tool-calling interface for on-demand capability composition in a shared context'。它针对的是长程 agent 的老毛病：'Updating shared parameters to learn new capabilities can degrade previously acquired ones, resulting in catastrophic forgetting'，而 'conventional joint training and static adapter merging maintain a fixed parameter configuration throughout execution'。证据是八个 deep-research benchmark：Qwen3-32B 上比 full fine-tuning 对手提升 '6.2% relative' 且 'using less compute'，比最强静态 LoRA 合并提升 '27.5% relative'；并支持 'modular continual adaptation'——新增 code computation adapter 不动 backbone 与其他 adapter。工程含义很直接：能力路由走的是模型原生 function-calling 通道，不需要额外 head、不需要改 serving 协议，是今日最容易落地的 '能力组合' 实现路径。代码 / benchmark / 项目页：摘要未给出，暂无可核验链接（待核验/暂无）。今日动作：评估给现有 agent 增加一个 '_switch_capability' 类工具的可行性。

top_papers.title: Train An Imaginative Agent
top_papers.abstract: A seemingly reasonable push in Sokoban can make the puzzle unsolvable. To avoid such mistakes, an agent has to anticipate the consequences of its actions before execution, especially when feedback from the real environment is sparse or actions are irreversible. We introduce Agentic Imagination (Agima), a training framework that trains an agent to imagine before acting, i.e. to be imaginative. Agima trains a single omni model to propose actions, generate images of their outcomes, and then reason
top_papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.26845）：Agima（Agentic Imagination）训练单个 omni 模型 'propose actions, generate images of their outcomes, and then reason over these imagined futures to decide what to execute in the real environment'，先 SFT 统一 policy 与 world model，再用 agentic RL 教它用这些想象中的未来做规划。最强的一条数字：'Trained with SFT alone on two-box Sokoban, Agima solves 40% of four-box puzzles while seeing the real board only once every five moves, compared with an action-only planner that only solves 2%'——在真环境反馈稀疏且动作不可逆时，'先想象再执行' 的收益是 20 倍量级。行为层面的证据比分数更有价值：'it learns a new unified format that was unseen during the SFT stage, learns to conduct forward thinking only when necessary, and branches more frequently at critical decision points'，即 'learn when and where to look ahead'。代码与项目页今日已实测可达：项目页 https://agima.net/ （HTTP 200），仓库 https://github.com/Agentic-Imagination/Agima 。属 ai-agent × multimodal-agent × llm-evaluation 的即时资产，但迁移风险必须写清：证据全部来自 Maze2D / Sokoban / Pacman / PushT 四个玩具环境，'generalizes to harder settings unseen during training' 尚未在真实工具链上验证。今日动作：先读仓库确认 omni 模型的训练成本量级。

top_papers.abstract: The goal of a world model is to capture the dynamics of an environment. This has the great appeal that it allows agents to plan and simulate a course of actions with the help of a world model. For these uses to be reliable, however, the learned dynamics must behave well beyond the specific state-action combinations observed in expert rollouts. top_papers.title: LatComm: Reusable Context Compression for Latent Communication between Large Language Models
top_papers.abstract: Systems that combine several large language models (LLMs) often use one context for many questions. When the context is passed between models as text, the receiving model processes all of its tokens again for every question. Avoiding this cost requires a context representation that is compact, reusable across questions, and readable by a different LLM. Existing compression and latent communication methods each provide only some of these properties. We introduce LatComm, a Latent Communication in
top_papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.26840）：LatComm 解决的问题很具体——'When the context is passed between models as text, the receiving model processes all of its tokens again for every question'。方法核心是把编码与读取拆开：'separating encoding from reading: the context is encoded once without the question, and the receiver selects what to read for each question'；冻结的 context encoder 压成 fixed-size packet，冻结的 receiver 通过 cross-attention 读取，且 'with gates computed from its prompt'。数字：'LatComm improves average accuracy over single-vector baselines by up to 10.2 points'（12 个 MCQ 数据集平均）；在 QuALITY 上 'it reduces the receiver's input by 57x and answers the questions of an article 3x faster'。价值路由：这是今日唯一一篇直接命中多模型串联系统里重复烧 token 这张真实账单的论文，属 context-engineering × inference-serving 的趋势资产。边界必须写清：latent communication 要求两端模型冻结且可挂 cross-attention，实际接入要改 receiver 架构，摘要提到的 'readable by a different LLM' 的泛化范围论文未给出。代码 / benchmark / 项目页：暂无可核验链接（待核验/暂无）。今日动作：记录为 context-engineering 趋势候选，触发条件是出现可即插即用的实现。

top_papers.title: Can It Actually Work? Synthesizing Functional CAD Mechanisms
top_papers.abstract: While LLM agents can generate visually plausible CAD assemblies, these designs often fail to fulfill their intended physical functions. We study functional CAD design, a setting where agents interpret underspecified requests to construct and iteratively revise mechanisms that satisfy functional requirements in physical simulation. Verifying these requirements is nontrivial: different candidate mechanisms may realize the same function through entirely different components, controls, and operating

top_papers.abstract: In this paper, we systematically investigate the mechanisms, scaling behavior, and generalization of physical Recursive self-improvement. We introduce PhysRSI-eval to quantify physical RSI through a five-axis metric: First-Attempt Performance, Efficiency, Success, Budget and Improvement from failure. Different VLMs are evaluated on 18 manipulation tasks under a fixed interaction budget. The analysis of experimental results motivates the Physical Barrel Hypothesis: different capabilities may cons
top_papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.26848）：这篇的稀缺之处是它质疑了 '物理自我改进' 这个概念本身的可测性。评测用五轴指标——'First-Attempt Performance, Efficiency, Success, Budget and Improvement from failure'——跑 '18 manipulation tasks under a fixed interaction budget'。最有诊断价值的是它指出公开 benchmark 均分接近的系统可被区分，且 'high scores need not come with early or efficient gains'，即总分掩盖了学习曲线的差异。工作区干预实验给了具体结论：'Removing history reduces late-round success, frozen workspaces remain useful on unseen layouts, and three cross-task cases achieve success earlier'，并由此提出 'scene-specific adaptation and reusable experience can coexist'。对评测治理的直接启发：单一均分不足以判断 agent 是否在 '学习'。代码 / benchmark / 项目页：暂无可核验链接（待核验/暂无）。今日动作：把五轴指标（尤其 Improvement from failure 与 Budget）抄进内部 agent 评测模板。

top_papers.title: Reinforcement Learning with Visually Attributable On-Policy Self-Distillation
top_papers.abstract: Multimodal reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) provides reliable task-level supervision, yet offers limited guidance for localizing errors in visual reasoning. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) complements this supervision with dense token-level corrections from a privileged teacher equipped with an evidence-centered visual view. However, the resulting corrections may conflate visual evidence with non-visual shifts induced by linguistic priors, response style, or the privilege
top_papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.26856）：VAG 形式化了一个我认为会被更多论文引用的概念——'a token-level correction is contaminated when its update direction cannot be consistently attributed to the privileged visual evidence'（论文将其命名为 privileged-correction contamination）。成因说得清楚：'the resulting corrections may conflate visual evidence with non-visual shifts induced by linguistic priors, response style, or the privileged view itself'，直接蒸馏会 'reinforce erroneous token-level updates'。解法是把 verifier 推出的 advantage 当锚，再用一个可判定的门控——'validates each privileged correction against the contrast between evidence-present and evidence-degraded teacher views'，只放行方向上被视觉对比支持的修正。证据是 'Experiments across six visual reasoning benchmarks' 上 'consistently outperforms GRPO and OPSD methods'，并自述为 SOTA 平均分。跨域启发：证据归因污染这个框架同样适用于用强模型给弱模型做纠正的场景（RAG grounding、工具输出蒸馏），不限于视觉。代码 / benchmark / 项目页：暂无可核验链接（待核验/暂无）；SOTA 结论为作者自述，未见第三方复现。

top_papers.title: CoopUQ: Robust Multi-Robot Social Navigation via Uncertainty-Aware Cooperative Forecasting
top_papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning enables mobile robots to make fast and scalable navigation decisions in constrained human-shared environments. However, directly extending single-robot approaches to multi-robot settings often fails to ensure safety and efficiency, especially under occlusions and out-of-distribution (OOD) scenarios, where individual robots may overlook potential risks or make inaccurate predictions. Leveraging cooperation effectively for both prediction and navigation remains a major chall
top_papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.26852）：CoopUQ 把多机器人导航里的一个工程直觉做成了显式机制——用不确定性而不只是占用预测来驱动策略：'predicts future occupancy grid maps through cross-robot spatiotemporal feature fusion and further leverages forecasts and their uncertainty to guide policy via constrained multi-agent reinforcement learning, where the cost penalizes navigation through regions predicted to be occupied or highly uncertain'。动机是单机器人策略在遮挡与 OOD 下 'often fails to ensure safety and efficiency'，因此作者称 'This design enables the policy to adapt its risk sensitivity under distribution shifts'。证据分两层：Unity3D 仿真下的 in-distribution + OOD 对比（含不同布局、行人流密度与 rushing 行为），加真机实验 'further demonstrate its robustness across various scenes'。代码与视频今日已实测可达：项目页 https://coopuq.github.io/ （HTTP 200），仓库 https://github.com/tasl-lab/CoopUQ 。长尾理由：领域（移动机器人社会导航）与本项目相关性低，但让不确定性显式进入代价函数、而不是只进感知置信度，是可迁移的可靠性模式。

top_papers.title: Text-to-Image Generative Modeling Without Language Pretraining
top_papers.abstract: Modern text-to-image (T2I) systems use internet-scale language pretraining for text-conditioned image generation. We ask whether language pretraining is necessary for strong T2I generation. We introduce Halcyon, a family of early-fusion multimodal autoregressive models pretrained entirely from scratch on GPIC, a dataset of 100M image-text pairs. Halcyon-0.52B outperforms LlamaGen-XL/8 (48.0 vs. 63.3 gFD) with 18.2$\times$ less pretraining compute. Further, Halcyon-1.6B outperforms JiT-T2I-XXL/8+
top_papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.26863）：Halcyon 是一次有价值的证伪型工作，问题是 'whether language pretraining is necessary for strong T2I generation'，做法是在 GPIC（100M 图文对）上从零预训练 early-fusion 多模态自回归模型族。两条带具体数字的对照：'Halcyon-0.52B outperforms LlamaGen-XL/8'（48.0 vs. 63.3 gFD）且预训练算力少 18.2 倍、'Halcyon-1.6B outperforms JiT-T2I-XXL/8++'（35.3 vs. 41.0 gFD）且预训练算力少 275 倍；最关键的一句是 'Controlled experiments show that text-only pretraining does not improve T2I generation'——整个领域的默认前提被受控实验否掉。项目页今日已实测可达：https://cs.stanford.edu/~keshik/halcyon （HTTP 200），页面显示 Models 已提供、Code 标注 coming soon，因此代码暂无可核验链接（待核验/暂无）。长尾理由：与本项目直接相关性低（文生图预训练），但某类预训练并非必需这类证伪结论在未来选型时可省下大量算力。
